model_reported.summary: Proposed a static contiguous-row scheduling contrast to the measured dynamic-row candidate while retaining the scalar pixel computation.

model_reported.name: inspecter-environnement
model_reported.summary: No hardware-specific choice was needed for this OpenMP scheduling experiment; the supplied target/compiler context is sufficient for the candidate.

model_reported.name: consulter-documentation-technique
model_reported.summary: The candidate uses a basic OpenMP static work-sharing directive and makes no claim dependent on an unverified API or instruction feature.

model_reported.name: evaluer-performances
model_reported.summary: Compared the available measured observations cautiously and left static-versus-dynamic performance to the controller's matching measurements.

memory_lessons.applicability: The prior dynamic-row candidate is a useful scheduling comparator, but the baseline observations do not separate one- and four-thread timings; they do not establish a static-versus-dynamic result.
memory_lessons.claim: The dynamic-row experiment was valid and measured 0.28208 seconds versus 0.56342 seconds for the serial baseline under the recorded protocol. This motivates measuring another decomposition, but does not isolate scheduling effects by core count.
memory_lessons.next_experiment: Compare static contiguous rows with the dynamic-row candidate at matching one- and four-thread settings, including n=1024 and shifted bounds.

proposal.hypothesis: With more than one usable worker, schedule(static) over rows assigns contiguous row blocks and may reduce dynamic queue overhead; however, Mandelbrot iteration costs can vary across those blocks, so static scheduling may also increase imbalance. The serial branch avoids OpenMP overhead for a one-thread team, and the requested team is capped by height. This contrasts with the prior dynamic-row experiment without changing the coordinate expressions or scalar recurrence.

retained: Extracted one row's unchanged float coordinate calculations and scalar Mandelbrot recurrence into a row helper shared by serial and parallel paths.
Added an OpenMP parallel-for over rows with schedule(static), using the default contiguous row partition.
Capped the requested team size by height and retained a serial path when the usable requested team has at most one thread.
